webui.openapi.docs.description: A testable API workspace for the public HTTP contract generated from the module code-first declarations.

webui.openapi.docs.legend.title: About this workspace
webui.openapi.docs.legend.detail: Browse operations by tag and execute requests from here: bearerAuth operations inject the token you enter (kept in memory, never persisted); webuiSession operations run with the browser session cookie and CSRF-bound mutations are signed like the WebUI itself. Execution requires a reachable backend; mock demo builds are browse-only.
